map.输入租客收入、信用、工作等信息，综合评估租客信用风险等级: Enter the tenant income, credit, employment and other information to comprehensively assess the tenant credit risk level
map.📖 查看「租客（信用/背景）评估 使用指南」: 📖 View the User Guide for Tenant (Credit / Background) Assessment
map.租客信用评分按维度加权：收入租金比（租金 ÷ 月收入，不超过 25% 得 100: The tenant credit score is weighted by dimensions: income-to-rent ratio (rent ÷ monthly income: ≤25% scores 100, 25%–33% scores 80, 33%–50% scores 50, >50% scores 20) + job stability (years employed, capped at 100) + linearly converted credit score + age and guarantor bonus; the total is converted to Excellent (≥80), Medium (60–79), Poor (<60); for the Poor tier, raise the deposit or require a guarantor.
map.📚 深度解析：租客信用与背景评分: 📚 Deep Dive: Tenant Credit and Background Scoring
map.出租前按租金收入比、工作年限、信用分、年龄与担保情况给租客打分，快速筛掉高风险申: Before renting, score tenants by rent-to-income ratio, employment tenure, credit score, age and guarantor status to quickly screen out high-risk applicants.
map.多个申请人横向比较综合评分，配合建议押金档位做取舍。: Compare multiple applicants horizontally on the composite score, and weigh against the suggested deposit tier.
map.合租或整租给公司时，用更低的风险等级换取更短的免租期或更高的押金。: When co-renting or leasing to a company, trade a lower risk tier for a shorter rent-free period or a higher deposit.
map.月收入 12 000、月租 4 000（租金收入比 33.3%，落在 >33%: Monthly income 12,000, monthly rent 4,000 (rent-to-income ratio 33.3%, falls in the >33% tier → income score 50); 5 years employed → 100; credit score 700 → (700−350)/6 = 58; age 32 (25–55 range) → 100; no guarantor → 50. Composite = 50×0.35 + 100×0.20 + 58×0.25 + 100×0.10 + 50×0.10 = 67.1 → Tier B (medium-low risk), suggested deposit 2 months. If monthly rent drops to 3,000 (ratio 25.0% → income score 100), composite rises to 84.6 → Tier A, deposit 1 month.
map.各项权重是多少？: What are the weights of each factor?
map.租金收入比 35%、工作稳定性 20%、信用评分 25%、年龄 10%、担保人: Rent-to-income ratio 35%, job stability 20%, credit score 25%, age 10%, guarantor 10%. The rent-to-income ratio has the highest weight because it is the single strongest predictor of default.
map.评分等级怎么对应押金？: How do score tiers map to the deposit?
map.≥80 分 A 级建议 1 个月押金，60–79 分 B 级 2 个月，45–5: ≥80 Tier A suggests 1 month deposit, 60–79 Tier B 2 months, 45–59 Tier C 3 months, <45 Tier D suggests rejecting or requiring a guarantor.
map.租金/收入比是核心指标，建议不超过33%（即收入≥3倍租金）: Rent-to-income ratio is the core metric; keep it ≤33% (i.e. income ≥ 3× rent)
map.信用评分参考央行征信或第三方信用分: Reference the central bank credit report or a third-party credit score for the credit score
map.工作年限越长，收入稳定性越高: Longer employment tenure means more stable income
map.有担保人可降低违约风险: Having a guarantor lowers default risk
map.建议查验身份证明、工作证明和征信报告原件: Recommend verifying the original ID, employment certificate and credit report
map.租客信用评估工具，从收入比、工作稳定性、信用评分、年龄、担保人五维度综合评估租客: A tenant credit assessment tool that comprehensively evaluates the tenant risk tier from five dimensions: income ratio, job stability, credit score, age and guarantor.
map.租金收入比 = 月租金 ÷ 月收入 × 100%；可支配余额 = 月收入 − 月: Rent-to-income ratio = monthly rent ÷ monthly income × 100%; disposable balance = income − rent. The ratio is only an affordability reference, not a score or rejection conclusion. Checklist progress counts actual ticks; credit score, income and work years only flag items to verify, not a weighted score. Personal data is processed only in this browser and is not uploaded.
map.工作年限 (年，仅用于核对稳定性): Work years (years, for stability checks only)
map.📚 深度解析：租客资料核对与负担能力参考: 📚 Deep Dive: Tenant Document Checklist and Affordability Reference
map.出租前把月收入、月租与资料核对项放在一张清单里，先算租金收入比，再逐项核实身份、: Before renting, put income, rent and document checks into one list: calculate the rent-to-income ratio, then verify identity, income, employment, credit, previous landlord reference and guarantor documents.
map.多名申请人并排比较时，只比较可核实事实与负担能力，不把年龄、性别、地域等与履约无: When comparing applicants, compare only verifiable facts and affordability; do not score age, gender, region or other factors unrelated to performance.
map.把结果作为面谈提纲：哪些资料已核对、哪些待补、租金占收入是否偏高，由房东结合当地: Use the result as an interview outline: which documents are checked, which are missing, and whether rent takes too much income; the landlord judges under local law.
map.租金收入比 = 4 000 ÷ 12 000 = 33.3%，月收入减租金 =: Rent-to-income ratio = 4,000 ÷ 12,000 = 33.3%; income minus rent = 8,000 CNY. With only identity and income statements ticked, progress is 2/6. The tool no longer outputs A/B/C/D risk grades, deposit months or rejection advice, and does not score by age; a credit score of 700 only flags the need to state its source and check the original report.
map.为什么不再给信用等级和押金建议？: Why are credit grades and deposit advice gone?
map.固定权重评分与拒租结论缺乏可验证的模型依据，也容易把年龄等无关因素变成歧视。工具: Fixed-weight scores and rejection conclusions lack a verifiable model and can turn irrelevant factors such as age into discrimination. The tool now shows a verifiable document checklist and rent-to-income ratio; the landlord decides using local law, proof of income, the original credit report and an interview.
map.不参与。页面已移除年龄评分；不得基于年龄、性别、地域等与履约无关的因素区别对待申: No. Age scoring has been removed; do not treat applicants differently based on age, gender, region or other factors unrelated to performance.
map.信用分从哪里来？: Where does the credit score come from?
map.工具不提供信用分，也不上传个人信息。若填写信用分，需自行注明来源并核对报告原件，: The tool does not provide a credit score or upload personal data. If entered, state the source and check the original report, such as a central-bank credit report or a licensed agency report; it can also be left blank.
map.本工具不输出信用等级、押金或拒租建议，也不按年龄评分: No credit grade, deposit or rejection advice, and no age scoring
map.租金收入比仅作负担能力参考，需结合实际支出自行判断: The rent-to-income ratio is only an affordability reference; judge with actual expenses
map.信用分须注明来源并核对报告原件（如央行征信或持牌机构报告）: State the credit-score source and check the original report (e.g., central-bank or licensed agency)
map.个人信息仅在本机浏览器处理，不上传服务器；不得基于年龄、性别、地域等无关因素区别: Personal data stays in this browser and is not uploaded; do not discriminate by age, gender, region or other irrelevant factors
map.输入租客收入、租金与可核实资料项，输出租金收入比、负担能力参考和资料核对清单；不: Enter tenant income, rent and verifiable documents to see the rent-to-income ratio, affordability reference and checklist; no automated grade, deposit advice or rejection.
map.不输出信用等级、押金或拒租建议: No credit grade, deposit or rejection advice
